scripts.start: npm run backend:build && npm run build && electron .
scripts.test:e2e: npm run backend:build && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run check:desktop && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.pack: npm run backend:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.adhoc.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run backend:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.adhoc.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:signed: node scripts/check-native-signing.mjs && npm run backend:build && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.signed.cjs --publish never && node scripts/verify-native-signing.mjs
scripts.check:desktop: node --test scripts/check-desktop-complexity.test.mjs && node scripts/check-desktop-complexity.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_desktop_complexity.py && python3 scripts/check-desktop-complexity.py && prettier --check "src/main/desktop/*.ts" "src/shared/desktop*.ts" "src/renderer/Desktop*.tsx" "src/renderer/desktop-*.css" "src/main/user-browser/*.ts" "src/shared/user-browser.ts" "src/renderer/UserBrowser.tsx" "browser-extension/control-*.js"
scripts.eval:browser-use: npm run backend:build && npm run build && tsc -p evals/browser-use/tsconfig.json && playwright test -c evals/browser-use/playwright.config.ts
